name: Campaign Monitor
description_en:
Campaign Monitor is a hosted email-marketing service with campaign design, subscriber lists, segmentation and automated journeys. A journey belongs to a list and starts from a defined trigger, such as joining a list, reaching a date or entering a segment. Email, delay, condition and field-update steps then shape the communication.

Operational details matter as much as the visual editor. Turning a journey off does not freeze subscriber time, editing an active delay differs from deleting it, and newer direct accounts use different billing rules from older accounts. This profile keeps those conditions explicit; no campaign or journey was executed.
description_zh:
Campaign Monitor 是提供邮件设计、订阅名单、分组及自动沟通路径的托管邮件营销服务。路径属于某个名单，由加入名单、到达日期或进入分组等明确定义的条件启动，再用邮件、等待、条件及字段更新步骤组织沟通。

运营细节与可视化编辑器同样重要：关闭路径不会冻结订阅者的时间，修改活跃等待步骤不同于删除，而较新的直客账户采用与旧账户不同的计费规则。本文明确这些条件，未实际执行邮件活动或路径。

sections.title_en: Model the list and trigger before the email sequence
sections.title_zh: 先设计名单和触发条件
sections.en:
Campaign Monitor’s designer asks for a journey name, list and trigger. Documented trigger families include joining a list, store actions, entering or exiting a segment, a date and its anniversary. Steps include email, delay, wait until, condition and custom-field changes.

For an illustrative renewal journey, a stored renewal date is meaningful only if the source data is correct and the selected trigger matches the desired calendar behavior. A visually complete diagram cannot establish that every subscriber has a usable date. Inspect representative records before activation.
sections.zh:
路径设计器先要求名称、名单和触发条件。文档的触发类型包括加入名单、商店动作、进入或退出分组、某个日期及其周年日；步骤包括邮件、延迟、等到指定时间、条件及自定义字段修改。

例如续期路径，只有来源数据正确且触发类型符合日历需求时，续期日期才有意义。流程图完整不能证明每位订阅者都有可用日期，启用前应检查代表性记录。

sections.title_en: Segment entry has a detection window
sections.title_zh: 分组进入存在检测窗口
sections.en:
The journey guide says segment updates are checked every 10 minutes. It also warns that a new segment-triggered journey has an initial monitoring delay: someone entering or leaving the segment during the first 10 minutes may not receive the email. It recommends waiting before testing.

A workflow needing immediate access or a time-critical alert should be evaluated against that documented behavior. Do not interpret a segment label changing on screen as proof that the corresponding message has already been sent.
sections.zh:
路径指南说明分组更新每 10 分钟检查一次，还提醒新的分组触发路径有最初监测延迟：前 10 分钟内进入或离开分组的人可能收不到邮件，因此建议等待后再测试。

需要即时访问权限或紧急通知的流程，应对照这个文档行为评估。界面上的分组标签已经变化，不代表对应邮件已经发送。

sections.title_en: Turning off does not pause the subscriber clock
sections.title_zh: 关闭不会暂停订阅者时钟
sections.en:
When a journey is off, new subscribers cannot trigger it. Existing subscribers continue to progress silently without receiving emails or field updates. Re-enabling it does not simply send every message they missed. The guide also describes date-field changes that can shift or remove people depending on the journey structure.

For a dated renewal sequence, define what a maintenance window should do to people already waiting. Check their expected next step after reactivation instead of treating the on/off switch as a reliable queue pause.
sections.zh:
路径关闭后，新订阅者不能触发，但现有人仍静默前进，不收到邮件或字段更新；重新启用也不会简单补发全部错过的邮件。指南还说明日期字段变化可能按路径结构移动或移除订阅者。

对有日期要求的续期序列，应明确维护期间如何处理已经等待的人。恢复后需核对预期下一步，不能把开关当作可靠的队列暂停。

sections.title_en: Deleting a delay can remove its waiting subscribers
sections.title_zh: 删除等待步骤可能移除等待中的人
sections.en:
The edit guide distinguishes three operations. Email content edits remain a draft while the old version continues sending; a save-and-return sequence publishes the new content. Changing a delay leaves current occupants on the original timing. Deleting a delay removes those currently waiting there from the journey.

Before simplifying a live renewal flow, inspect waiting counts. The guide suggests a zero-length delay as an alternative to deleting an occupied delay. Treat that as a documented migration option to evaluate with your own records, not a recovery test completed by this profile.
sections.zh:
编辑指南区分三种操作：修改邮件时先保存草稿，旧版继续发送，经过保存并返回路径的流程才发布新版；修改延迟时，已等待的人沿用原时间；删除延迟则会把正在该处等待的人移出路径。

简化活跃续期流程前应检查等待人数。指南建议可把延迟改为零，避免删除已有人等待的步骤。这是需要用自有记录评估的文档迁移方式，不是本文已完成的恢复测试。

sections.title_en: An address on two active lists counts twice
sections.title_zh: 同一邮箱在两个活跃名单中计两次
sections.en:
Both billing articles count an address separately when it is active on multiple lists, while unsubscribed, bounced, unconfirmed or deleted entries do not count as active subscribers. The docs recommend segments to avoid unnecessary cross-list duplication.

A hypothetical 400 people active on two lists can therefore mean 800 counted subscriptions, even though there are only 400 distinct addresses. Preserve real communication boundaries, but do not create duplicate lists merely to represent an interest filter without considering the billing consequences.
sections.zh:
两篇计费文章都将多名单中的同一活跃邮箱分别计数，已退订、退信、未确认或删除记录不计活跃订阅者。文档建议用分组减少不必要的跨名单重复。

假设 400 人同时活跃于两个名单，就可能计为 800 个订阅条目，即使只有 400 个不同邮箱。应保留真实沟通边界，同时避免仅为兴趣筛选而随意复制名单，忽略计费后果。

sections.title_en: Choose the billing rules for the actual account generation
sections.title_zh: 按真实账户代际选择计费规则
sections.en:
The official pages distinguish legacy accounts from new direct customers using Chargebee from August 2026. The Chargebee guide describes automatic prorated tier increases and says the higher tier persists until manually downgraded. The legacy guide instead describes temporary send-limit waivers. They must not be collapsed into one policy.

For Chargebee, Lite counts all email types against its limit, Essentials has unlimited campaign/journey/RSS sends with a separate transactional allowance, and Premier is documented with no send limit. The legacy document still caps Premier transactional sends. Confirm account generation and plan terms; the public pricing amounts did not render, so no normalized purchase price is asserted.
sections.zh:
官方页面区分旧账户与 2026 年 8 月起采用 Chargebee 的新直客。Chargebee 指南说明超额会自动按比例升档，且高档位保留到手动降档；旧指南则介绍临时发送额度豁免，不能合并成统一政策。

Chargebee 下 Lite 将全部邮件计入额度；Essentials 的活动、路径和 RSS 不限发送，但事务邮件另有限额；Premier 文档写为无发送上限。旧文档仍限制 Premier 的事务发送。应确认账户代际及套餐条款；公开价格金额未呈现，本文不设标准购买价。

sections.title_en: Budget for ongoing operation and uncertain payment recovery
sections.title_zh: 预算包含持续运营及待确认的支付恢复
sections.en:
The current billing article contains inconsistent payment-failure descriptions: its account-status section allows continued sending during retries, while its FAQ says sending is unavailable pending updated payment details. This profile cannot resolve that conflict without account-specific confirmation.

Campaign Monitor is worth evaluating for a list-based newsletter or lifecycle sequence with someone responsible for timing, data quality and live edits. It is a managed service in the material read; self-hosting rights, interface-language coverage, exact current price and real payment-recovery behavior remain unverified. Marketing Studio appears on the current pricing page as a related content-generation surface, not an independently tested content-quality guarantee.
sections.zh:
当前计费文章对支付失败有相互不一致的描述：账户状态段允许重试期间继续发送，FAQ 却表示更新支付资料前不能发信。没有账户专项确认，本文无法消解该冲突。

有专人负责时间、数据质量和活跃流程修改的名单简报或生命周期序列，可评估 Campaign Monitor。已读资料描述的是托管服务；自托管权利、界面语言、确切现价和真实支付恢复行为仍未核实。当前价格页中的 Marketing Studio 是相关的内容生成入口，不能当作已独立测试的内容质量保证。

research_gaps.en: Public paid amounts were missing. The Chargebee article contradicts itself on sending during payment retries; confirm actual account behavior before relying on continuity.

research_gaps.en: No account, campaign, journey, deletion, payment failure or recovery was tested. UI languages, source license, regional terms and deployment rights remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、活动、路径、删除、支付失败或恢复；界面语言、源码许可、地区条款和部署权利仍未核实。
